# TeamForge

> TeamForge is an open-source real-time collaboration project for the Unity Editor, covering live Scene synchronization, connected-user presence, same-Scene Hierarchy collaboration, locking and ownership, and direct P2P project bootstrap and transfer.

This is the v2-compatible discovery index for the TeamForge GitHub Pages project path. Older llms.txt clients can continue to read the same H1, summary, H2 sections, and Markdown link lists; v2-aware clients can additionally discover this file through `rel="describedby"` and page Markdown variants through `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"`.

Retrieval and evidence contract: use current source plus tests for implementation facts, `STATUS` for current capability and release readiness, `release-contract.json` for exact current runtime/protocol/release identity, and the exact Release filename plus SHA-256 for packaged byte identity. Do not treat roadmap or historical notes as implemented behavior.

Current source contract: product `0.5.1`, release ID `0.5.1-wp5.1-path-resilience`, state `FIELD_BLOCKED`. Current `main` can be newer than the latest published packaged candidate while remaining in the same product/release lineage.

`P2P` currently means direct Project Peer payload transfer. It does not imply automatic discovery, WebRTC/ICE/STUN/TURN, relay transport, or automatic Internet NAT traversal.

## Start here

- [Project overview](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/index.md): Human-oriented project overview mirrored as clean Markdown.
- [Current status](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/status/index.md): Current capabilities, validation state, limitations, source-versus-package boundary, blockers, and release readiness.
- [How TeamForge works](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/how-it-works/index.md): End-to-end Host, Guest, direct project transfer, realtime authority, reconnect, and recovery flow. Canonical source: `docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md`.
- [Release contract](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/release-contract.json): Exact current product, release, runtime, protocol, and target identity.
- [Project metadata](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/project.json): Generated Pages snapshot metadata, source commit, and discovery routes.
- [Repository manifest](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/repository-manifest.json): Exhaustive git-tracked file inventory for the exact Pages source commit.

## Modules

- [Unity Editor package](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/unity-package.txt): Unity Editor client, collaboration services, Host UX, and Editor tests.
- [Realtime coordination server](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/server.txt): Authoritative realtime/session coordination and signed Project metadata coordination.
- [Project Peer](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/project-peer.txt): Direct Project Transfer v1, Host/Guest orchestration, trust, and activation backend.
- [Windows Guest Launcher](https://eun-si123.github.io/teamforge-unity-collab/modules/launcher.txt): Guest Launcher, bundled runtime verification, diagnostics, trust UX, and Unity handoff.
